vault.name: Global Media Link Vault
vault.rule: Every studio that generates an asset (audio, video, image, 3D, pattern) MUST register it with mediaVault.push({ type, name, url, meta }) in real time. No asset is allowed to live only inside its generating studio's local state. Consumers (App/Web Builders, CapCut Video Timeline, Viral Mockup, Storyboard Supervisor, Voice/Dub Lab) must read from mediaVault via useMediaVault() and never request manual user downloads.

crossPollination.audio-to-video-timeline: mediaVault assets of type 'audio'/'musicvideo' feed the CapCut Video Studio audio track via drag-drop (video-studio/page.tsx drop handler listens for mediaVault payloads).
crossPollination.image-to-video: image type assets feed the CapCut video prompt box + the Viral Mockup device sandbox.
crossPollination.image-to-appbuilder: image type assets feed the App & Web Builder and Cosmic UI Lab preview surfaces.
crossPollination.storyboard-to-studios: Visual Storyboard Supervisor routes prompts to Krea Image Studio, Freebeat Video Studio, Voice Lab by mutating the vault after generation downstream.
crossPollination.mv-to-api-connector: MV Studio pushes generated tracks to the API Connector payload ledger for distribution.
